Since JWST's first images on 2022-07-12, group published images into bursts by date_taken: an image starts a new burst when it was taken more than 7 days (168 hours) after the previous image. How many bursts are there, and how many images are in the largest one?

function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH d AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
    LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
),
b AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
    CASE WHEN prev IS NULL OR date_taken - prev > INTERVAL '168 hours' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start
  FROM d
),
g AS (
  SELECT date_taken, SUM(is_start) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS burst
  FROM b
)
SELECT count(*) AS burst_count, max(cnt) AS largest FROM (SELECT burst, count(*) cnt FROM g GROUP BY burst)"}

biggest AS (
  SELECT burst FROM sizes ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

),

  SELECT subject, count(*) AS subject_count
  FROM members GROUP BY subject ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT min(date_taken) FROM members) AS start_date,
  (SELECT max(date_taken) FROM members) AS end_date,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM members) AS image_count,
  (SELECT subject FROM top_subject) AS subject,
  (SELECT subject_count FROM top_subject) AS subject_count"}

Since JWST's first images on 2022-07-12, group published images into bursts by date_taken: an image starts a new burst when it was taken more than 7 days (168 hours) after the previous image. How many bursts are there, and how many images are in the largest one?

function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_taken) <= 2026
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT date_taken,
         CASE WHEN prev IS NULL OR date_taken - prev > INTERVAL 168 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new
  FROM ordered
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT date_taken, SUM(is_new) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS burst_id
  FROM flagged
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_bursts, MAX(c) AS largest
FROM (SELECT burst_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM numbered GROUP BY burst_id)"}

{"sql": "WITH webb AS (
  SELECT * FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS','FGS')

         DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY w.instrument ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM webb w GROUP BY w.instrument, w.subject
)

       ROUND(100.0 * r.n / t.total, 1) AS pct
FROM ranked r JOIN totals t USING (instrument)

function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT photo_id, instrument, date_taken, subject, modality,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_date
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec')
    AND date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12 00:00:00'
    AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05 00:00:00'
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken AS end_date,
         date_diff('day', prev_date, date_taken) AS gap_days
  FROM ranked WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
),
max_gap AS (
  SELECT instrument, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap FROM gaps GROUP BY instrument
)
SELECT g.instrument, mg.max_gap, g.end_date,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jwst_space_images s
                      WHERE s.instrument = g.instrument AND s.modality = 'spectrum_or_plot')
             / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jwst_space_images s2
                WHERE s2.instrument = g.instrument), 1) AS pct_spectra
FROM gaps g JOIN max_gap mg USING (instrument)
WHERE g.gap_days = mg.max_gap
ORDER BY g.instrument"}

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT photo_id, instrument, date_taken,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_date
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec')
    AND date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12 00:00:00'
    AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05 00:00:00'
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken AS end_date,
         date_diff('day', prev_date, date_taken) AS gap_days
  FROM ranked WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
),
max_gap AS (
  SELECT instrument, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap FROM gaps GROUP BY instrument
),
pct AS (
  SELECT instrument,
         ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE modality = 'spectrum_or_plot') / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_spectra
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec')
  GROUP BY instrument
)
SELECT g.instrument, mg.max_gap AS gap, g.end_date, p.pct_spectra
FROM gaps g JOIN max_gap mg USING (instrument) JOIN pct p USING (instrument)
WHERE g.gap_days = mg.max_gap
ORDER BY g.instrument"}

function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH j AS (
  SELECT p.photo_id, EXTRACT(year FROM p.date_taken) AS yr, l.gate_category,
         (p.photo_id IN (SELECT photo_id FROM jwst_space_images)) AS published
  FROM photos p JOIN labels l USING(photo_id)
  WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM p.date_taken) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
),
per_year AS (
  SELECT yr, COUNT(*) AS labelled,
    ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN NOT published THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct_unpublished
  FROM j GROUP BY yr
),
mode AS (
  SELECT yr, gate_category,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, gate_category) AS rn
  FROM j WHERE NOT published GROUP BY yr, gate_category
)
SELECT per_year.yr, per_year.labelled, per_year.pct_unpublished, mode.gate_category
FROM per_year JOIN mode ON per_year.yr = mode.yr AND mode.rn = 1
ORDER BY per_year.yr"}

       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.not_published) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_not_published,

function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH totals AS (
  SELECT instrument, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS','FGS')
  GROUP BY instrument
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT j.instrument, j.subject, COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY j.instrument ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, j.subject) AS rnk
  FROM jwst_space_images j
  JOIN totals t ON j.instrument = t.instrument
  GROUP BY j.instrument, j.subject
)
SELECT r.instrument, r.subject, ROUND(100.0 * r.n / t.total, 1) AS percentage
FROM ranked r JOIN totals t ON r.instrument = t.instrument
WHERE r.rnk = 2
ORDER BY r.instrument"}

function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken,
         LAG(date_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_date
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec')
    AND date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken < TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, prev_date, date_taken,
         DATE_DIFF('day', prev_date, date_taken) AS gap_days
  FROM ranked
  WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
),
max_gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken AS end_date, gap_days,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY gap_days DESC, date_taken) AS rn
  FROM gaps
),
pct AS (
  SELECT instrument,
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN modality = 'spectrum_or_plot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_spectra
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec')
  GROUP BY instrument
)
SELECT m.instrument, m.gap_days, CAST(m.end_date AS DATE) AS end_date, ROUND(p.pct_spectra, 1) AS spectra_pct
FROM max_gaps m JOIN pct p USING (instrument)
WHERE m.rn = 1
ORDER BY m.instrument"}

function.name: run_sql
run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH valid AS (
  SELECT date_taken, photo_id, subject
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12' AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'
), ordered AS (
  SELECT *, lag(date_taken) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS prev_dt
  FROM valid
), flagged AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_dt IS NULL OR date_diff('millisecond', prev_dt, date_taken) > 168*3600*1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new
  FROM ordered
), numbered AS (
  SELECT *, sum(is_new) OVER (ORDER BY date_taken) AS burst_id
  FROM flagged
), burst_sizes AS (
  SELECT burst_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM numbered GROUP BY burst_id
), largest AS (
  SELECT burst_id FROM burst_sizes ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT min(n.date_taken) AS burst_start,
       max(n.date_taken) AS burst_end,
       b.cnt AS image_count,
       s.subject AS most_common_subject,
       s.subject_count
FROM numbered n
JOIN largest l ON n.burst_id = l.burst_id
JOIN burst_sizes b ON b.burst_id = l.burst_id
JOIN (
  SELECT subject, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, subject) AS rn
  FROM numbered WHERE burst_id = (SELECT burst_id FROM largest)
  GROUP BY subject
) s ON s.rn = 1

function.name: submit_answer
function.arguments:
{"sql": "WITH dts AS (
  SELECT instrument, date_taken,
         LEAD(date_taken) OVER (PARTITION BY instrument ORDER BY date_taken) AS next_dt
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS')
    AND date_taken >= TIMESTAMP '2022-07-12'
    AND date_taken <  TIMESTAMP '2027-01-01'
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, DATE(next_dt) - DATE(date_taken) AS gap_days, DATE(next_dt) AS end_date
  FROM dts
  WHERE next_dt IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(next_dt) - DATE(date_taken) >= 0
),
maxgaps AS (
  SELECT instrument, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap
  FROM gaps GROUP BY instrument
)
SELECT m.instrument, m.max_gap AS gap, g.end_date,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.modality = 'spectrum_or_plot' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
             / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_spectra
FROM maxgaps m
JOIN gaps g ON g.instrument = m.instrument AND g.gap_days = m.max_gap
JOIN jwst_space_images i ON i.instrument = m.instrument
GROUP BY m.instrument, m.max_gap, g.end_date
ORDER BY m.instrument"}

         COUNT(*) AS n_images,
         COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_taken)) AS n_years,
         MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_taken)) AS first_year,
         MAX(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_taken)) AS last_year,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE instrument IN ('NIRCam','MIRI','NIRSpec','NIRISS','FGS')) AS n_single_instrument
  FROM jwst_space_images
  WHERE object_name_normalized IS NOT NULL AND trim(object_name_normalized) <> ''
    AND date_taken IS NOT NULL
    AND date_taken <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-05'  -- exclude impossible future dates
  GROUP BY object_name_normalized
)
SELECT object, n_images AS image_count, first_year, last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * n_single_instrument / n_images, 1) AS pct_single_instrument
FROM obj
WHERE n_years >= 3
ORDER BY object"}
